annotations.title: Set what counts as up (main URL)

description: Replace the rule for the app's main URL: an exact status code, text the page must contain, and/or a JSON field. Fields you leave out are cleared, so pass everything you want to keep. Needs write access.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

expect_status.description: Exact status code that counts as up, e.g. 200. Omit: any 2xx or 3xx.

expect_text.description: Text the response must contain, from one line of the page

json_path.description: JSON field that must exist, like status or checks[0].ok
